item.title: Kim Kyoung-soo becomes sole progressive candidate for South Gyeongsang governor…Ulsan's re-primary concludes tomorrow (김경수, 경남지사 범진보 단일후보…울산은 내일 재경선 결판)
item.description:
The unification of candidates for the Ulsan mayoral election in the June 3 local elections, which had nearly collapsed between the Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party, was dramatically revived on the 27th. Both sides decided to conduct a public opinion poll, including measures to prevent "strategic voting," on the 28th, one day before the start of early voting, to determine a single candidate. In South Gyeongsang Province, the candidates unified after Jeon Hee-young, the Progressive Party candidate for governor, declared her support for Kim Kyoung-soo, the Democratic Party candidate for governor. (결렬 직전까지 갔던 더불어민주당과 진보당의 6·3 지방선거 울산시장 후보 단일화가 27일 극적으로 회생했다. 양쪽은 사전투표 시작일 하루 전인 28일 하루 동안 ‘역선택 방지’ 장치를 포함한 여론조사를 실시해 단일 후보를 결정하기로 했다. 경남에서는 전희영 진보당 경남지사 후보가 김경수 민주당 경남지사 후보 지지를 선언하면서 후보가 단일화됐다.)

Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party candidate for Ulsan mayor, held an emergency press conference at his election office in Nam-gu, Ulsan, around 1 PM that day, stating, "I deliberated deeply and repeatedly. I thought about the urgent need to end the conflict and discord between the Democratic and progressive camps," and added, "I will accept the request from Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party candidate, for a re-primary to unify the candidates." In response, Kim Sang-wook held a press conference at his own election office and replied, "I am grateful for candidate Kim Jong-hoon's courageous decision." The two plan to conduct a unification poll from 9 AM to 5 PM on the 28th, determining the winner that same day. Both sides announced that they had smooth working-level discussions on the specific survey method to prevent strategic voting, finalized by Lee Yeon-hee, the head of the Democratic Party's Strategic Planning Committee, and Shin Chang-hyeon, the Secretary-General of the Progressive Party. ( 김종훈 진보당 울산시장 후보는 이날 오후 1시께 울산 남구 선거사무소에서 긴급 기자회견을 열어 “고심하고 또 고심했다. 민주·진보 진영의 갈등과 반목이 지속돼서는 안 된다는 절실함을 생각했다”며 “김상욱 민주당 후보의 단일화 재경선 요구를 받아들이겠다”고 말했다. 이에 김상욱 후보도 자신의 선거사무소에서 기자회견을 열어 “김종훈 후보의 용기 있는 결단에 감사하다”고 화답했다. 두 사람은 28일 오전 9시부터 오후 5시까지 단일화 여론조사를 실시해 당일 승자를 가릴 예정이다. 양쪽은 역선택 방지를 위한 구체적 조사 방식을 두고 이날 실무 협의를 벌여 원만히 합의했다고 밝혔다. 실무 협의는 이연희 민주당 전략기획위원장과 신창현 진보당 사무총장이 매듭지었다.)

The candidate unification between the two parties had nearly fallen through when Kim Sang-wook declared a halt to the primary on the 24th, the second day of polling, citing the Progressive Party's failure to include anti-strategic voting provisions in the survey. ( 양당의 후보 단일화는 김상욱 후보가 여론조사 이틀째인 지난 24일 진보당이 여론조사에서 역선택 방지 조항을 담지 않은 점을 문제 삼으며 여론조사 경선 중단을 선언하면서 무산 직전까지 갔다.)

With the Democratic Party and Progressive Party again agreeing to candidate unification, the Ulsan mayoral election now narrows to a two-way race between a unified Democratic-Progressive candidate and Kim Doo-kyum, the People Power Party candidate. According to a telephone survey conducted by Korea Research for KBS from the 21st to the 23rd, Kim Sang-wook received 37%, Kim Doo-kyum 32%, Kim Jong-hoon 15%, and independent candidate Park Maeng-woo 3% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (민주당과 진보당이 다시 후보 단일화에 합의하면서, 울산시장 선거는 민주·진보 단일 후보 대 김두겸 국민의힘 후보의 양자 대결 구도로 좁혀지게 됐다. 한국리서치가 한국방송(KBS) 의뢰로 지난 21일부터 사흘간 전화면접 조사를 한 결과, 김상욱 후보 37%, 김두겸 후보 32%, 김종훈 후보 15%, 박맹우 무소속 후보 3%를 기록했다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

However, some observers suggest that the effectiveness may be diminished due to the fallout from the suspension and resumption of the unification process. ( 그러나 단일화 중단·재개 후유증 탓에 효과가 반감될 수 있다는 관측도 나온다.)

A Progressive Party official in Ulsan said, "It is true that within the Progressive Party, there is strong opposition and anger over candidate Kim Sang-wook's side agreeing to the initial survey method (without anti-strategic voting measures) and then belatedly demanding a re-poll." Cho Seung-rae, the Secretary-General of the Democratic Party, publicly apologized at a press briefing at the National Assembly that afternoon, saying, "We deeply apologize for the bewilderment and shock that the Progressive Party leadership and members must have felt due to the suspension of the unification," seemingly in acknowledgment of this atmosphere within the Progressive Party. Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae also posted on Facebook, "I am grateful for the Progressive Party's magnanimous decision." ( 진보당 울산 지역 관계자는 “최초 조사 방식(역선택 방지 장치가 없는 조사)에 김상욱 후보 쪽도 합의해놓고 뒤늦게 재조사를 요구한 것에 대해 진보당 내 반발과 분노가 거센 것이 사실”이라고 말했다. 조승래 민주당 사무총장이 이날 오후 국회 기자간담회에서 “단일화 중단으로 진보당 지도부와 당원이 받았을 당혹감, 충격에 대해서 깊은 사과의 말씀을 드린다”며 공개 사과한 것도 이런 진보당 내 분위기를 의식한 것으로 보인다. 정청래 민주당 대표도 페이스북에 “진보당의 대승적 결단에 감사하다”는 글을 남겼다.)

Meanwhile, Jeon Hee-young, the Progressive Party candidate for South Gyeongsang governor, withdrew her candidacy that day while declaring support for Democratic Party candidate Kim Kyoung-soo. Consequently, the South Gyeongsang governor election will now be a two-way race between Kim and Park Wan-soo, the People Power Party candidate. ( 한편, 전희영 진보당 경남지사 후보는 이날 김경수 민주당 후보 지지를 선언하면서 후보직을 사퇴했다. 이로써 경남지사 선거는 김 후보와 박완수 국민의힘 후보의 양자 대결로 치러지게 됐다.)

Reported by Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr, Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr, and Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Ramming of the 'HMM Naju' Points to Iran"...Intent and Perpetrator Not Concluded (“나무호 타격, 여러 증거가 이란 향해”…고의성·주체는 단정 안 해)
item.description:
On the 27th, the South Korean government effectively pointed to Iran as the perpetrator behind the striking of the South Korean cargo ship HMM Naju in the Strait of Hormuz, presenting multiple pieces of evidence, but stopped short of confirming whether it was a deliberate attack or naming the specific entity responsible. While demanding an apology from Iran and assurances against recurrence, the government appears to have taken into account the safety of the 25 South Korean ships still in the Strait of Hormuz, the security of South Korean nationals in Iran, and diplomatic relations with Iran. <<> First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo announced the results of the government's joint investigation into the attack on the Naju, stating that the aerial vehicle that struck the ship is highly likely an Iranian-developed 'Noor' series anti-ship missile. The announcement came 23 days after the Naju was attacked on the 4th. <<> The government presented several pieces of evidence, including analysis results of the aerial vehicle's engine, warhead, explosives, and airframe found on the Naju, along with related photos. According to the evidence, the warhead of the aerial vehicle was similar to Iran's Noor anti-ship missile or its improved variant, the 'Qader', and parts bore engravings from an Iranian manufacturer. An analysis by the Agency for Defense Development also confirmed characteristic features of the Iranian 'Toloue 4' engine. The government also released a photo of sky-blue airframe debris, matching the color of Iranian Noor-series anti-ship missiles. <<> At the time of the attack on the 4th, the Naju was anchored inside the Strait of Hormuz near UAE waters, with its stern facing toward Iran, and the missile struck the stern—the side of the ship facing Iran. The investigation did not determine where the projectile was launched. However, the Ministry of National Defense estimated that, given the Naju was about 90–100 km from mainland Iran at the time, the missile may have traveled for about 6–7 minutes. <<> Vice Minister Park stated, "Multiple pieces of evidence point to Iran," but when asked if it was a deliberate attack targeting a South Korean ship, he replied, "It is very difficult to confirm," adding, "Unless they admit it, determining intent itself is extremely challenging," thus speaking cautiously. <<> The government also said it is not easy to specify the exact entity responsible for the attack, such as Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), regular military, or militia forces. However, Deputy Minister for International Affairs at the Ministry of National Defense, Rear Admiral Ryu Yoon-sang, stated, "Iranian-produced missiles are understood to be primarily used by the Iranian Navy, the IRGC, and pro-Iranian forces. They have also been exported to other countries, including Syria." He added, "We judge that control of the Strait of Hormuz is essentially handled by the IRGC and the Navy." Regarding the simultaneous launch of two missiles at the Naju, he said, "It is judged that they were fired with the intention of causing damage." <<> The remaining task is for the government to respond. On the evening of the same day, Vice Minister Park summoned Iranian Ambassador Saeed Kouzachi to explain the investigation results and demand responsible measures, including prevention of recurrence, as well as an apology. However, Ambassador Kouzachi denied Iranian involvement in response to reporters' questions, stating, "The tense situation in the Middle East was caused by American aggression." <<> The government now faces the task of securing an apology or a promise to prevent recurrence from Iran, which has been denying the attack itself since the Naju incident. It also needs to ensure the safety of the 25 South Korean ships and their crews stranded in the Strait of Hormuz for over three months without provoking Iran. Vice Minister Park said, "We plan to continue communication regarding the safety of our ships and the protection of our overseas nationals," and "We will urge that free and safe navigation for all ships, including ours, be ensured." <<> Whether to join the 'Maritime Coalition of Freedom' (MFC), a multinational coalition proposed by the US to open the Strait of Hormuz, has also emerged as a matter of interest. Vice Minister Park stated, "We have the will to participate in efforts and resolve regarding freedom of navigation," but added, "Given that additional information needs to come from the US side, it is difficult to specify concrete participation plans at this point." <<> Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (정부가 27일 호르무즈해협에서 한국 화물선 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호를 타격한 주체가 이란이라고 사실상 지목하고 여러 증거를 제시하면서도 고의적 공격 여부나 공격 주체에 대해서는 명확히 밝히지 않았다. 이란에 사과와 재발 방지를 요구하면서 여전히 호르무즈해협에 있는 25척의 한국 선박과 이란 내 교민 안전, 이란과의 외교 관계 등을 복합적으로 고려한 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-hoon Accepts 'Re-election'…Who Will Be the Ulsan Democratic-Left Unified Candidate? [Gongdeok Pocha] (‘재경선’ 받아들인 김종훈…울산 민주진보 단일후보는 누구? [공덕포차])
item.description:
The unification process for the Ulsan mayoral candidacy, which was on the brink of collapse between Kim Sang-wook of the Democratic Party of Korea and Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party, has resumed. On the 27th, Candidate Kim Jong-hoon stated, "I accept Candidate Kim Sang-wook's demand for a re-election primary for unification," and added, "We will unite as a single democratic-left candidate to answer the public's fervent desire to purge the forces of insurrection." This means he has accepted Kim Sang-wook's request to conduct a public opinion poll-based primary that includes an 'anti- strategic voting clause'. <<> Initially, the Progressive Party maintained that since the two parties had previously agreed not to include an anti-strategic voting clause, the public opinion poll should be resumed according to that agreement. Now that Candidate Kim Jong-hoon has accepted Kim Sang-wook's demand, the unification is expected to be finalized by the 28th, the deadline for indicating 'withdrawal' on the advance voting ballot for the June 3 local elections. <<> What was the real reason Candidate Kim Sang-wook suddenly halted the unification public opinion poll? Who will become the single democratic-left Ulsan mayoral candidate? Why are the number of closely contested districts increasing as the local elections draw nearer? We find out at Gongdeok Pocha. item.title: Kim Nam-joon of Gyeyang-eul: "I will take over the unfulfilled promises of President Lee and complete them" (계양을 김남준 “이 대통령이 못 지킨 공약 이어받아 완성할 것”)
item.description:
"I will complete the unfulfilled promises of President Lee Jae-myung." (“이재명 대통령이 못다 이룬 약속을 완성하겠다.”)

Kim Nam-joon, the Democratic Party candidate running in the June 3 by-election for Gyeyang-eul in Incheon, said this in a phone interview with *The Hankyoreh* on the 27th. Gyeyang-eul was President Lee's former constituency, and Candidate Kim is known as one of President Lee’s closest confidants. He joined President Lee’s staff during his time as Seongnam mayor, served as Deputy Director of Political Affairs during his tenure as party leader, and later worked as First Deputy Chief of Staff and spokesperson at the presidential office. (6·3 인천 계양을 국회의원 보궐선거에 나선 김남준 더불어민주당 후보는 27일 한겨레와 전화 인터뷰에서 이렇게 말했다. 계양을은 이 대통령 지역구였고, 김 후보는 이 대통령의 최측근으로 불린다. 성남시장 시절 이 대통령 보좌진으로 합류했고, 당 대표 시절 정무부실장으로 일했다. 청와대에서는 제1부속실장과 대변인을 지냈다.)

— You’re called ‘President Lee’s closest confidant.’ Doesn’t that label or scrutiny feel burdensome? (―‘이재명의 최측근’이라고 불린다. 이런 평가나 시선이 부담되진 않나?)

“It’s up to me whether I take it as just a burden or turn it into a driving force for achieving results. Naturally, I have to choose the latter. That’s why I set the election concept as ‘Kim Nam-joon will take over and complete President Lee Jae-myung’s promises.’ I believe this is the golden opportunity to fulfill the unfinished pledges.” (“부담으로만 받아들일지, 성과를 내는 동력으로 활용할지는 제게 달려있다. 당연히 후자로 가야한다. 그래서 이번 선거 콘셉트를 ‘이재명 대통령의 약속을 김남준이 이어받아서 완성하겠다’로 잡았다. 지금이 못다 한 공약을 실행할 수 있는 골든타임이라고 생각한다.”)

— It’s been a year since President Lee resigned to run for presidency, and now you’re returning to Gyeyang. (―이 대통령이 대선 출마를 위해 사퇴한 뒤 1년 만에 계양에 돌아왔다.)

“Among residents, there’s a strong sense of pride and self-esteem about having produced a president. Some people even say, ‘Our neighborhood is the president’s village.’” (“주민들 사이에서는 대통령을 배출했다는 자부심과 자긍심이 굉장히 높아져있다. ‘우리 동네는 대통령 마을’이라고 이야기하는 분들도 계신다.”)

— There are criticisms that you yourself have no ties to Gyeyang. (―후보 본인은 계양에 연고가 없다는 비판이 있는데.)

“To offset such assessments, I need to deliver tangible results in this area and earn the recognition that I’m someone the residents need. I began my political career here under my own name. I will lay down roots in Gyeyang until I achieve real outcomes and finish my political journey.” (“그런 평가들을 상쇄시키기 위해서라도 이 지역에서 실질적인 성과를 내고, 주민들에게 필요한 사람이라는 평가를 받아야 한다. 저는 이곳에서 제 이름을 건 정치를 시작했다. 실질적 성과를 내고 정치를 마무리할 때까지 계양에서 뼈를 묻겠다.”)

— What do you think is the most important local issue? (―가장 중요한 지역 현안은 무엇이라 생각하나?)

“When I meet residents, many talk about transportation. The physical distance from Seoul is close, but it takes too long to get out. I’ve announced transportation pledges for the first time, such as extending the Daejang-Hongdae Line metropolitan subway to Gyeyang. Additionally, Gyeyang faces low fiscal independence and is seen as a bedroom community. I aim to attract ‘anchor companies’ to ensure the Gyeyang Techno Valley plays its proper role.” (“주민들을 만나보면 교통을 이야기하는 분들이 많다. 서울과 물리적 거리는 가까운데, 나가는 데 시간이 너무 오래 걸린다는 것이다. 대장~홍대선 광역철도를 계양까지 연장하는 것 등 교통공약을 처음으로 발표했다. 또 계양은 재정자립도가 낮고 베드타운이라는 평가가 있다. ‘앵커기업’을 유치해 계양테크노벨리가 제대로 역할 할 수 있게 만들겠다.”)

— What kind of work did you do as President Lee’s aide? (―이 대통령의 참모로서는 어떤 일들을 했나?)

“I did so much—political affairs, strategy, public relations—that there’s almost nothing I haven’t tried. Starting from Seongnam, I was responsible for shaping the image and identity of the politician Lee Jae-myung, even suggesting appearances on the variety show *Dreams Come True*. In the National Assembly, I served as a district office aide and as Deputy Director of Political Affairs under the party leader, observing how a district lawmaker works and how the party operates. At the presidential office, I assisted the president as First Deputy Chief of Staff and worked as a spokesperson.” (“정무, 전략, 홍보 등 안 해봤던 게 없을 정도로 많은 일을 했다. 성남에서부터 이재명이라는 정치인의 이미지와 정체성을 담당하며 ‘동상이몽’(방송 예능프로그램) 출연을 제안하기도 했다. 국회에선 지역구 보좌관으로, 당 대표 정무부실장으로 일하며 지역구 의원이 일하는 방식과 당이 움직이는 방식을 지켜봤다. 청와대 1부속실장으로 일하며 대통령을 보좌하고 대변인으로 일했다.”)

— What prompted you to decide to step into politics yourself? (―본인의 정치를 해야겠다고 결심한 계기는?)

“It seems like a natural process. It’s about going from being a ‘staffer’ to a ‘player.’ I became aware that I was heading down that path, and with recommendations from those around me, I thought, ‘This is my destiny.’ What really made me decide to step up was during my time as Deputy Director of Political Affairs under the party leader.” (“자연스러운 과정이었던 것 같다. ‘스태프’에서 ‘플레이어’가 되는 것인데, 제가 그 길로 가고 있다는 걸 자각하게 되고 주변에서 추천받기도 하면서 ‘내 운명이다’ 생각했다. 정말 나서야겠다고 결심한 것은 당 대표 정무부실장 시절이다.”)

— If elected, what is your goal as a lawmaker? (―당선된다면 국회의원으로서의 목표는?)

“I want to continue the sovereignty-centered politics I learned from President Lee. I’ve seen too many cases where people, once entrusted with power, mistakenly believe the power belongs to them. President Lee has practiced politics that places the sovereign people at the center, where the citizen is the subject. Since a president’s term is limited, I want to ensure that the ‘Lee Jae-myung spirit’ continues to lead political culture even beyond that.” (“이 대통령에게 배운 주권자 중심의 정치를 이어가고 싶다. 권력을 위임받으면 권력이 정치인 자신의 것이라고 착각하는 경우를 너무 많이 봤다. 이 대통령은 주권자를 중심에 놓는, 주어가 국민이 되는 정치를 해왔다. 대통령 임기는 정해져 있으니, 그 이후로도 ‘이재명 정신’이 정치문화를 이끌어갈 수 있도록 하고 싶다.”)

— You’re also close to the presidential office staff. If elected, will you act as a liaison between the party and the presidential office? (―청와대 참모들과도 가까운 사이인데, 당선될 경우 당·청 간 소통 역할도 하게 되나?)

“Even when I meet with residents or others, there are requests for me to play a communication role. If such a role is needed, I’ll do it, as I’m open to taking on whatever is required.” (“주민들이나 다른 분들을 만나도 소통 역할을 해 달라는 요구들이 있다. 필요한 역할은 뭐든 하겠다는 취지에서 그런 역할이 요구된다면 그것도 해내겠다.”)

Go Kyung-joo, Reporter goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)
